features: Dual-Tone Design: Striking visual contrast that defines CMF’s distinctive aesthetic
Up to 35 dB Adaptive ANC: Intelligently reduces background noise for a more immersive and focused listening experience
12.4 mm Dynamic Drivers: Delivers deeper, more powerful bass for an enhanced audio experience
Spatial Audio & Professionally Tuned EQ Presets: Customize your listening experience with immersive sound and multiple EQ options
Up to 52 Hours Total Playback: Enjoy up to 52 hours of listening time with ANC off
Up to 11 Hours Playback per Charge: Long-lasting battery life for everyday use
Fast Charging: Just 10 minutes of charging provides up to 5.5 hours of playback
Nothing X App: One app for all your devices, providing complete control and customization
Dual-Device Connection: Connect to two devices and switch between them automatically
